product.title: Jackson Hole Horseback Riding & Lunch in Bridger Teton NF

description.text: Escape the crowds of nearby Yellowstone and Grand Teton national parks and experience Bridger-Teton National Forest like the west's cowboys: on horseback. After getting fitted with a horse suited to you, you'll follow your guide across high alpine meadows, through groves of aspen, up into the mountains, and along the Buffalo Fork River. Combining serenity, scenery, and thrills, it's part local tradition but all one giant adventure.Go for a horseback ride through one of the country's most beautiful landscapes, no expertise required Explore the Teton backcountry without breaking a sweat Easy mee Ideal for travelers basing in Jackson Hole who want a guided Wyoming outing without self-driving mountain roads.
